architectureFindings.finding: Ordinal performance rank, accumulated stars, and average criteria score were not distinct canonical concepts.
architectureFindings.resolution: Added performance_rank and performance_star_total while retaining quality_score for the average criteria score.

architectureFindings.finding: Employee identifiers exported as numbers conflicted with a string-only registry contract.
architectureFindings.resolution: Employee ID now explicitly permits string and numeric physical representations.

architectureFindings.finding: The metric preflight reused SUM-oriented additivity rules and blocked a valid non-additive score average.
architectureFindings.resolution: Added a governed average safety path requiring a numeric canonical measure, no parse failures, no repeated score risk, atomic rows, and an independently proven entity identity.

architectureFindings.finding: XLSX runtime materialization used the first worksheet row rather than the canonical selected header row.
architectureFindings.resolution: Propagated canonical headerRowIndex through the runtime source and parser.

architectureFindings.finding: Trailing workbook-header whitespace caused canonical bindings and DuckDB runtime identifiers to diverge.
architectureFindings.resolution: Runtime row keys and governed query identifiers now share trim-plus-lowercase normalization.

semanticBindings.physicalColumn: Tổng sao từ T6/2016 đến T05/2017
